notes: In Arabic, to say 'to look AT something', you must use the preposition 'إِلَى' (ila) after the verb, as in 'نَظَرَ إِلَى'.
Do not confuse this with 'رَأَى' (ra'a), which means 'to see' or 'to perceive' without necessarily directing one's gaze intentionally.
